Dr.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "Kern's conclusion on this point is that Vikramâditya, according", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "to the unanimous testimony of Hindu Astronomers, of the Ara-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 4, "text": "", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "bian Astronomer Albiruni, of Kalhâna Pandit, and of Hiouen", "end": "space"}, {"n": 6, "text": "Thsang, was the founder of what is commonly known as the S'aka", "end": "space"}, {"n": 7, "text": "or S'âlivâhana Era, and flourished about 78 A. C., and not 56 B.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 8, "text": "C.[*] If we accept this opinion, and it has certainly an immensely", "end": "space"}, {"n": 9, "text": "higher weight of authority to support it than the rival opinion, it", "end": "space"}, {"n": 10, "text": "is possible, I think, to reconcile the several statements which we", "end": "space"}, {"n": 11, "text": "receive from tradition. For there will now be an interval of two", "end": "space"}, {"n": 12, "text": "centuries and upwards between Patanjali and Bhartṛihari, which", "end": "space"}, {"n": 13, "text": "gives \"ample room and verge enough\" for all the events in the his-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 14, "text": "tory of the Mahâbhâshya alluded to above. Now considering that", "end": "space"}, {"n": 15, "text": "an entirely independent line of argument has brought us to the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 16, "text": "conclusion that Bhartṛihari must be a good deal older than the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 17, "text": "close of the fifth century, considering that all the various items", "end": "space"}, {"n": 18, "text": "of information can be reconciled by placing Bhartṛihari about the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 19, "text": "beginning of the so-called S'âlivâhana Era, we may take it, I", "end": "space"}, {"n": 20, "text": "think, as a conclusion, grounded on a basis by no means un-", "end": "hyphen"}, {"n": 21, "text": "stable, that our author flourished about the close of the first and", "end": "space"}, {"n": 22, "text": "the beginning of the second century of the Christian Era.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r3", "type": "paragraph", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "I am not aware that this conclusion affects, or is affected by,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "any established propositions in the history of Sanskrit Literature.", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "It has been suggested above, that our author was probably later", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "than Kâlidâsa; but the date of Kâlidâsa himself[†] cannot be re-", "end": "hyphen"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r4", "type": "footnote", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "* See Kern's Preface to Bṛihatsanhitâ pp. 4-12 particularly p. 11.", "end": "space"}], "uncertain": false, "note": null}, {"id": "r5", "type": "footnote", "lines": [{"n": 1, "text": "† See \"Was the Râmâyaṇa copied from Homer?\" p. 39 and Muir's", "end": "space"}, {"n": 2, "text": "Texts II., 12 there cited. And see too Calcutta Review for October 1873,", "end": "space"}, {"n": 3, "text": "where the writer arguing from the references to the Hûṇas in the", "end": "space"}, {"n": 4, "text": "Raghuvans'a comes to the conclusion that Kâlidâsa lived some time", "end": "space"}, {"n": 5, "text": "before 100 A.
